_note: Final mix, two-seed version (2026-11-16): the four resolution-336 ConvNeXt-Base models of the contrastive family (control and same-crop mixing 0.5, seeds 42 and 45) mixed with v10.3 (CLIP ViT-B/16 with LoRA, the VLM branch's config) trained on seeds 42 and 45 on this machine (test HM 67.09 and 70.48 alone). ConvNeXt side: the four models' crop and disease log-probabilities are averaged, pair score = 1.75 * log P(crop) + log P(disease). CLIP side: mean of the two runs' log-probabilities over the 333 pairs. Mix = clip_weight * CLIP + (1 - clip_weight) * ConvNeXt, gamma subtracted from seen pairs. Built from finished runs by train/supcon_eval/mix_v103_two_seeds.py (validation choice, then one test read) and mix_v103_report.py (report files). Rule fixed before the test read: this version replaces the one-seed mix (mix_res336_v103) whatever its test score, because both sides now use both seeds and the weight is chosen with all four ConvNeXt models. The 384-resolution runs (full_scmix_res384[_s45]) failed the both-seeds rule and are not members.
_result: Test HM Top-1 77.00 / Top-5 95.73; seen 66.5, unseen 91.4. Gamma 0: HM 26.81 (seen 75.5, unseen 16.3). Chosen on the mean validation HM of six splits (seeds 42-44 with the seed-42 models, 45-47 with the seed-45 models): clip_weight 0.45, gamma 7.5, validation HM 68.82 (per split 64.37 / 67.69 / 71.12 / 70.58 / 70.56 / 68.59) against 64.74 for the ConvNeXt side alone and 60.12 for CLIP alone. Test read once. For comparison: one-seed mix 76.38, the four 336 models alone 76.11, v6.3 74.99. Gains of this size (+0.6 over the one-seed mix, +0.9 over the ConvNeXt side alone) are inside the seed-to-seed noise of about 2 points (v10.3 itself moved 3.4 points between its two seeds). To disclose: on validation each split sees one CLIP seed and two ConvNeXt models, on test both CLIP seeds and all four ConvNeXt models are averaged; crop weight 1.75 is carried over from Run 23.
title: convnext336_x4_v10.3_x2_mix

members._note: convnext: contrastive-family runs (method cnn_supcon), averaged with equal weights. clip: CLIP + LoRA runs, averaged in log-probabilities.

ensemble._note: clip_weight and gamma chosen on validation (grid: clip_weight 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05, gamma 0 to 15 in steps of 0.25); crop_weight fixed beforehand.
